creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Comments jump while scrolling a thread whenever the sticky ancestor bar appears or disappears.

`AncestorBar` returns `null` when the chain is empty (`app/item/ancestor-bar.tsx:84`). Scrolling between a top-level comment and a reply toggles the bar, and its height (about 36px) is added to or removed from the flow above the comments, so everything below shifts.

Fix direction: keep the bar's space reserved while it is empty, or position it so it overlays the comments instead of pushing them.

From chat note MfsTjhRGpzY (2026-08-29): "comments jump when scrolling when the poster train top element disappears or appears".
title: thread view: sticky ancestor bar makes comments jump
